status.scope: production Overview and History; public checks completed on 18/10/2026
status.validationBoundary: Approved interface deployed to both HTTPS hostnames. Public checks covered Overview/History rendering, live telemetry availability, source popups, report links, themes, English/Greek/Russian labels, desktop/mobile layouts, assets and unchanged report bytes. The finish disposition records the earlier local design review. No independent electrical-measurement accuracy or device-control operation was verified; no restart or report publication was requested.

extensions.colorRampNote: Tonal ramps are synthesized display-only swatch aids, not additional application tokens or approved palette requirements.

motion.name: language-trigger
motion.value: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease

motion.name: reduced-motion

focus.name: dark-focus

extensions.snippetContext: Examples use inherited --theme-* CSS properties from the application. Literal legacy component values are retained where the source does not expose a custom property. No imports, remote assets, or framework runtime are required. Series color may be supplied as --series by the existing history palette.

asset.role: Decorative conceptual home; not the actual installation.

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 28px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 16px 0; color: #425f52; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a[aria-current] { color: var(--theme-text); } .ds-nav a[aria-current]::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 0; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--theme-accent); } .ds-nav a:not([aria-current]):hover { color: var(--theme-accent); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #518b77; outline-offset: 4px; } :host-context([data-theme="dark"]) .ds-nav a:not([aria-current]) { color: var(--theme-muted); } :host-context([data-theme="dark"]) .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--theme-focus); } :host-context([data-theme="dark"]) .ds-nav a:not([aria-current]):hover { color: var(--theme-accent); }

components.name: Series toggle

components.css: .ds-series { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 42px; padding: 7px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #425f52; font: 12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-series::before { content: ""; width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--series, var(--theme-grid)); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-series[aria-pressed="true"]::before { background: var(--series, var(--theme-grid)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--theme-surface); } .ds-series[aria-pressed="false"] { color: var(--theme-muted); text-decoration: line-through; } .ds-series:hover { background: #e6eee8; } .ds-series:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #518b77; outline-offset: 4px; } :host-context([data-theme="dark"]) .ds-series { color: var(--theme-text); } :host-context([data-theme="dark"]) .ds-series:hover { background: var(--theme-hover); } :host-context([data-theme="dark"]) .ds-series:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--theme-focus); }

narrative.overview:
A calm operating interface makes the home's present readings and recorded history easy to inspect. Mineral off-white, deep evergreen, opaque surfaces, fine outlines, and restrained system typography give measurements priority. Source colors and the existing brand remain recognizable.

This reference captures the implemented, user-approved Overview B and History concepts. Their page compositions are specific to those tasks; future pages should reuse the visual language without automatically inheriting a house diagram, an insights column, or a chart-first layout.
keyCharacteristics: Opaque mineral and evergreen surfaces with quiet outlines.
Measurements, units, coverage, and freshness remain visible.
Purposeful page hierarchy with equivalent access in English, Greek, and Russian.

rules.name: The State and Label Rule
rules.body: Pair source and status color with text, units, selection state, or a visible mark; color alone must not carry the meaning.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Keep W/kW, V, A, %, and kWh attached to their actual quantities. Power formatting changes to kW at an absolute magnitude of 1000 W; voltage and current retain their own units.

rules.name: The Surface Scope Rule
rules.body: Preserve the approved compositions on Overview and History without turning their structure into a requirement for every future surface.

rules.name: The Data Truth Rule
rules.body: Missing measurements remain unavailable; do not invent values, infer unsupported battery voltage, or present simulated preview readings as live telemetry.

dos: Do preserve all available electrical measurements, their units, signed battery direction, coverage, and freshness.
Do keep English, Greek, and Russian translations, light/dark themes, keyboard access, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do retain source-specific chart colors and visible selection cues.
Do retain the illustration provenance and label simulated preview data clearly.
donts: Don't convert missing measurements into zero or add battery voltage that the public feed does not supply.
Don't hide A, W/kW, or V readings to simplify a small-screen layout.
Don't present future time as a recording gap or a saved review as a live alert.
Don't treat Overview or History composition as a universal page template.
